package.description: Personal video surveillance software for webcams and ip-cams

en-US.description: Personal video surveillance software for webcams and ip-cams
en-US.longDescription: ImWatcher is a professional video surveillance system with support for multiple web cameras and IP-cameras. It can monitor and record from many cameras simultaneously, and preview multiple cameras in a single window. Each camera has its own individual monitoring and recording settings. When motion is detected, it can record a video or take snapshots.
en-US.name: ImWatcher

zh-CN.description: 用于网络摄像头和 IP 摄像头的个人视频监控软件
zh-CN.longDescription: ImWatcher 是一款专业的视频监控系统，支持多个网络摄像头和 IP 摄像头。它可以同时监控和记录多个摄像头，并在一个窗口中预览多个摄像头。每个摄像头都有自己独立的监控和录制设置。当检测到运动时，它可以录制视频或拍摄快照。
zh-CN.name: ImWatcher
